chapter.heading: A Joyful Return to ZionA Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
When the
Lord brought back the captivity of Zion,We were like those who dream. [Ezra 9:15; Ps. 51:4; Jer. 11:20]

Then our
mouth was filled with laughter,And our tongue with singing.Then they said among the nations,“The Lord has done great things for them.” [Is. 29:13; Ezek. 33:31; Matt. 15:8; Mark 7:6 1 Most]

The Lord
has done great things for us,And we are glad. [Jer. 17:18; 50:27; James 5:5] [Ps. 17:3 e Ps. 7:9; 11:5; Jer. 11:20]

Bring back
our captivity, O Lord,As the streams in the South. [Jer. 23:10; Hos. 4:3 h Jer. 9:10; Hos. 4:3; Hab. 3:17 i Ps.]

Those who
sow in tearsShall reap in joy. [Josh. 3:15; 1 Chr. 12:15]

He who
continually goes forth weeping,Bearing seed for sowing,Shall doubtless come again with rejoicing,Bringing his sheaves with him. [Ps. 12:2; Prov.] [Gen. 37:4-11; Job 6:15; Ps. 69:8; Jer. 9:4,]
